Name: Junimo Farm Helper
Author: sskerye
Description:
[size=5][b]Junimo Farm Helper (祝尼魔农场帮手)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

Adds a new farm building: the [b]Small Junimo Hut[/b]. Once built, its Junimos spend the day gathering nearly everything your farm produces and storing it in the hut for you — crops, fruit, animal goods, forage, and more.

[size=4][b]The building[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Built by Robin for [b]8,000g + 100 Wood + 50 Stone[/b], finished in 1 day, footprint 3×2 tiles.[/*]
[*]Click the hut to open its built-in [b]144-slot storage[/b], where everything the Junimos collect is waiting for you. The storage menu also keeps the familiar toggle to pause or resume Junimo harvesting.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What the Junimos collect[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Ripe crops across the whole farm[/*]
[*]Fruit from fruit trees[/*]
[*]Moss from mossy trees[/*]
[*]Wild forage, including truffles[/*]
[*]Animal produce from your barns and coops — eggs, milk, wool and more, including anything stored in auto-grabbers (modded animal products work too)[/*]
[*]Tapper products: maple syrup, oak resin, pine tar[/*]
[*]Battery packs from lightning rods and solar panels[/*]
[*]Contents of supply crates[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Better than a vanilla Junimo Hut[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Whole-farm range[/b] — no small harvest radius; the Junimos search the entire farm.[/*]
[*][b]Works in rain and winter[/b] — vanilla Junimos hide in bad weather; these don't.[/*]
[*]Works from [b]6:00 AM to 7:00 PM[/b] every day.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Works on the main farm only; it does not work in the Greenhouse.[/*]
[*]Crops are still harvested by real Junimos walking out of the hut — you keep the vanilla look and feel, just with far more helpful helpers.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Only the host needs to install this mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI, then ask Robin to build a Small Junimo Hut.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]

Remove the mod folder to uninstall. Any Small Junimo Huts already built will no longer function; take your stored items out of the hut before removing the mod.

[line]

[size=5][b]祝尼魔农场帮手 (Junimo Farm Helper)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]模组功能[/b][/size]

新增一种农场建筑：[b]小型祝尼魔屋[/b]。建成后，屋里的祝尼魔会每天出门，把农场里几乎所有的物产都帮你收好，存进小屋等你取用——庄稼、水果、畜产品、采集品等等。

[size=4][b]建筑说明[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]由罗宾建造，花费 [b]8,000 金 + 100 木材 + 50 石头[/b]，1 天完工，占地 3×2 格。[/*]
[*]点击小屋即可打开内置的 [b]144 格大容量储物空间[/b]，祝尼魔收集的所有东西都在这里。储物界面还保留了原版开关，可随时暂停或恢复祝尼魔工作。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]祝尼魔会收集什么[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]全农场成熟的庄稼[/*]
[*]果树上的果实[/*]
[*]树上的苔藓[/*]
[*]野外采集品，包括松露[/*]
[*]鸡舍和畜棚里的动物产品——鸡蛋、牛奶、羊毛等等，包括自动采集器里积存的内容（模组添加的动物产品同样支持）[/*]
[*]树液采集器产品：枫糖浆、橡树树脂、松焦油[/*]
[*]避雷针和太阳能板产出的电池组[/*]
[*]补给箱里的物资[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]比原版祝尼魔屋更强[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]全农场范围[/b]——没有小小的收获半径限制，祝尼魔会搜遍整座农场。[/*]
[*][b]雨天和冬天照常工作[/b]——原版祝尼魔坏天气会躲起来，它们不会。[/*]
[*]每天 [b]早上 6 点到晚上 7 点[/b] 工作。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]注意事项[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]只在主农场生效；温室里无效。[/*]
[*]庄稼仍由祝尼魔走出小屋亲手收获——保留原版的画面和感觉，只是帮手能干得多。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]多人游戏[/b][/size]

只需房主安装本模组。

[size=4][b]前置要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]将模组文件夹解压到游戏的 Stardew Valley/Mods 目录。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，然后找罗宾建造小型祝尼魔屋。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]卸载说明[/b][/size]

删除模组文件夹即可卸载。已建造的小型祝尼魔屋将失效；卸载前请先把小屋里存放的物品取出。
